Chain of six short-track stories, all merged and DoD-complete: (1) daga-s1 -- Docker image .dockerignore fix to include artefacts/ and .github/, found while checking fapg-s1 live on production ('looks the same on prod'); DoD marked COMPLETE with a real live-page check named as its own most important, but non-blocking, follow-up action. (3) cpco-s1 -- a forked performance deep-dive found @playwright/test's own postinstall downloading all 3 browsers on every npm ci across every CI job; fixed with PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD + actions/cache for Chromium where actually needed; real measured improvement (75-85% faster on the two heaviest install-bound jobs). (6) THE MOST SIGNIFICANT FINDING: the operator asked for daga-s1's own recommended live-page check a full session-day after that DoD was marked COMPLETE -- it FAILED. Root cause: the Dockerfile's production stage uses an explicit COPY allowlist and never had a line for artefacts/ or .github/ at all; daga-s1's own .dockerignore fix was necessary but not sufficient. Fixed as dcfx-s1, which this time performed the live-page check immediately after promotion (same session as the fix) -- confirmed via real authenticated browser session, including clicking into a genuine expandable per-story accordion. daga-s1's own DoD was amended with a CORRECTION section (not rewritten) documenting what actually happened.
